$comment: SSOT domain shape: contracts/schemas/training/session_block.schema.json. Instantiated from .contract_driven/templates/modulos/schemas template. Module: training.
title: SessionBlock
description: SSOT JSON Schema for the SessionBlock domain entity (module: training). Training block within a session — the operational DSL unit of session planning. TRAIN-DEC-049, DEFER-TRAIN-P2-006 (resolved 2026-03-16). INV-TRAIN-083: Elastic Sum Rule enforced cross-block at API level. TRAIN-DEC-047: references exercise_id + exercise_version_id, never embeds Exercise.

sessionId.description: FK to TrainingSession. Immutable after creation.

orderIndex.description: 0-based position within session. (sessionId, orderIndex) is unique.

durationMinutes.description: Planned block duration. INV-TRAIN-083: SUM across blocks enforced at API level.

blockObjective.description: Explicit pedagogical objective of this block.

exerciseId.description: Optional reference to Exercise. TRAIN-DEC-047: training references, never embeds.

exerciseVersionId.description: Required when exerciseId is present. TRAIN-DEC-048, INV-EXB-007.

isOptional.description: When true, block may be skipped at execution without invalidating session.

examples.notes: Atenção à saída da ponta direita.
